source_evidence: Day328~11:40 exact player 'I need to know exactly what I am signing up for. All the details… all the product… all the people' asks for detailed due diligence before any commitment; no payment, agreement, access rights or other undertaking. Mara willingly Helps, noting a partner cannot responsibly assess liabilities or profits without knowing merchandise, operations and counterparties. Predeclared Deception+10 with advantage, DC17 actual business scope, DC22 sensitive participants and financial arrangements. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch c67b47400f137c349fdc41e242efc3b3 faces11,14, keep14+10=24, both thresholds met, no limited feature used. Harthvale accepts the request as appropriate from a prospective partner and permits the keeper to explain the association's own business, not disclose every unrelated customer's private account. Fixed scope from prep/dm-only/dm-ferry-setup.md @72d5bde0ab9d84d89fdc63f20cf9c7bfb63b1516: three trading households, three shallow-draft cargo boats, two leased storehouses, one rented office, legal freight alongside knowingly undeclared luxury imports, no ownership of the river or other criminal networks. Names newly assigned in play, after repository exact-name searches returned zero matches: route broker Orren Vaskel (same broker V met previously); keeper Berric Sornell (same accountant whose books V inspected); escort captain Tavren Holtwick; three member trading households Dunmere, Rellwick and Branthor. These are naming of existing roles and three existing households, not new staff or extra faction. Chair Harthvale says he coordinates the association and approves payment expenses; Vaskel arranges cargo/customer dealings, Sornell keeps the accounts, Holtwick supervises protection of cargo/crews. The keeper describes four principals including chair, seven additional escorts and four participating boat/warehouse hands, without purporting to identify every ordinary hired porter or every individual's knowledge. No troop deployment or current whereabouts inferred. Merchandise: specifically confirmed imported lace, plus newly established in-play product categories of fine imported silk cloth/ribbons and other expensive woven fabrics, within fixed luxury-import scope; association also carries ordinary declared freight, no claimed exhaustive list of every consignment, trafficking in people, weapons, poisons or other prohibited commodities, no new conspiracy. Harthvale states the patron seeking preferred exclusivity is Lady Halvessa Veldrake acting through Sallow, consistent with fixed PATRON role and their actual prior statements. Conditional250gp proposal not paid or accepted. Keeper openly identifies existing Lot27 sale36gp and D3206gp/D3238gp warning payments through broker reimbursement as actual prior examples; no duplicate receipts, no invented turnover, margin, debt or currently verified cash balance. 250gp capital proposal is not binding; actual profit share, liabilities and member assent not settled. Harthvale does not concede violence or knowledge of murders, and no new crime established. Keeper agrees V may take notes on the information he is willingly showing but retains the ledgers, and provides no blanket access to individual customer accounts. V has not yet chosen to write/copy, sign, commit or spend; no new document custody except existing Harthvale memorandum. He offers to go through the association's income, expenses and liabilities in greater detail before negotiating any investment, rather than claiming all financial due diligence complete. Mara, Cirren and Fenar hear disclosures; Desen not yet informed of today's findings. Await V's next action.
